en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small spa or resort town nestled in rolling hills. The foreground shows a complex of substantial masonry buildings with pitched roofs, towers, and pavilion‑like structures surrounded by dense trees and parkland. A broad, tree‑lined avenue leads uphill through the center toward more villas and resort houses. On a hill in the left background stands a church with a tall spire. In the right background is a large, ornate building with an arcade or colonnade that looks like a spa or Kurhaus. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
